belts.name: Survival
belts.premise: Stop being afraid of the editor. Modes, saving, undo, and typing text on purpose.

chapters.title: Modes and the escape hatch
chapters.teaches: normal vs insert vs command, Esc, why letters are commands; hjkl/0/$ are allowed here as survival tools only

chapters.title: Saving, quitting, undoing
chapters.teaches: :w :q :wq :q! ZZ, u, Ctrl-R, undo tree basics

chapters.title: Getting into insert mode well
chapters.teaches: i a I A o O, insert-mode editing keys, when not to stay in insert

belts.name: Movement
belts.premise: Never touch an arrow key again. Move by meaning, not by distance.

chapters.title: hjkl and the count prefix
chapters.teaches: hjkl, counts, relative line numbers, why 5j beats holding a key

chapters.title: Word motions
chapters.teaches: w b e ge, WORD vs word, counts with words

chapters.title: Inside a line: 0 ^ $ f t
chapters.teaches: 0 ^ $ g_ f F t T ; , as precision instruments

chapters.title: Across the file and the screen
chapters.teaches: gg G nG, { } ( ) , H M L, Ctrl-D/U/F/B, zz zt zb, %

belts.name: The grammar
belts.premise: Verb plus object. Learn ten verbs and twenty objects and you get two hundred edits for free.

chapters.title: Delete, change, yank, put
chapters.teaches: d c y p P x s r, doubled operators dd cc yy, linewise vs charwise

chapters.title: Operator + motion = edit
chapters.teaches: dw d$ c3w y}, counts on either side, the composition rule

chapters.title: Text objects: inner and around
chapters.teaches: iw aw i" a" i( a( i{ it at ip, and picking the right one

chapters.title: The dot command
chapters.teaches: . as repeat, designing edits to be dot-repeatable, cgn

belts.name: Search and replace
belts.premise: Find and change things you cannot see, safely, across thousands of lines.

chapters.title: Searching inside a file
chapters.teaches: / ? n N * #, incsearch hlsearch, search as a motion, offsets

chapters.title: Regex for people who edit code
chapters.teaches: vim regex dialect, magic levels, classes, anchors, groups, \zs \ze

chapters.title: Substitute with judgement
chapters.teaches: :s ranges flags, gc, backreferences, \=, case tricks, & and :&&

chapters.title: The global command
chapters.teaches: :g and :v, :g//d, :g//normal, :g//m0, :g//t$, the power tool

belts.name: Many files
belts.premise: A real change is never in one file. Move through a codebase without losing your place.

chapters.title: Buffers, windows and tabs
chapters.teaches: buffer list, :b :bn :bd, splits, Ctrl-W family, tabs and when they are wrong

chapters.title: Getting back where you were
chapters.teaches: Ctrl-O Ctrl-I, jumplist, changelist g; g,, marks m ' `, '' and `.

chapters.title: Opening a file by name
chapters.teaches: :e :find with path, wildmenu, netrw, :Explore, argument list

chapters.title: Quickfix: fix every hit in the repo
chapters.teaches: :vimgrep :grep, :copen :cn :cp, :cdo :cfdo, location lists

belts.name: Power tools
belts.premise: The features that make people watching you ask what just happened.

chapters.title: Registers
chapters.teaches: named registers, append, yank register 0, black hole, system clipboard, :reg

chapters.title: Record once, replay forever
chapters.teaches: q recording, @ @@, counts, recursive macros, editing a macro, macros over quickfix

chapters.title: Visual mode and the column trick
chapters.teaches: v V Ctrl-V, gv, o, visual text objects, blockwise I A $, :'<,'>

chapters.title: Completion, folding, spelling, formatting
chapters.teaches: Ctrl-N Ctrl-P Ctrl-X family, folds, spell, gq gw, = indenting

belts.name: Ex and automation
belts.premise: The command line under the editor. Where repetitive work goes to die.

chapters.title: The ex command language
chapters.teaches: :d :m :t :y :pu :j :>, :sort, addressing, command-line editing and history, q:

chapters.title: Ranges and :normal
chapters.teaches: line ranges, . $ % marks patterns, :normal, :g with :normal, argdo bufdo windo

chapters.title: Talking to the shell
chapters.teaches: !motion, :r !, :w !, filtering through sort/jq/prettier, :term

chapters.title: Options and how vim is configured
chapters.teaches: :set, local vs global, :verbose set, filetype, autocmds, mappings, leader

belts.name: Mastery
belts.premise: Make it yours, then use it for a living.

chapters.title: Building your own vimrc
chapters.teaches: growing a config one line at a time, sensible defaults, debugging a config

chapters.title: Plugins and the ecosystem
chapters.teaches: packages, plugin managers, fuzzy finders, surround, commentary, fugitive

chapters.title: IDE workflows without an IDE
chapters.teaches: LSP, go-to-definition, rename symbol, diagnostics, tags, git inside vim

chapters.title: Where Neovim differs
chapters.teaches: what changes, lua config, built-in lsp and treesitter, when to switch

chapters.title: Boss fights: real engineering work
chapters.teaches: multi-file features, refactors, code review, merge conflicts, under time pressure; reading a log or stack trace back to a cause
